notes:
v4.6.34 — IBKR order execution for custom bots (broker abstraction layer)

🏦 CUSTOM BOTS NOW EXECUTE THROUGH IBKR
• New core/broker_client.py abstraction: the BotRunner framework gets either Alpaca's TradingClient (UNCHANGED — zero regression risk) or an IBKR shim backed by ib_async, picked at launch from APEX_BROKER.
• Every bot you build in Make Bot (anything other than LONG / SHORT / DAY) now talks to IBKR when started in IBKR mode — connects to your gateway, fetches account / positions, places market orders with its assigned Client ID.
• Bot subprocesses launched in IBKR mode now receive APEX_IBKR_HOST / APEX_IBKR_PORT / APEX_IBKR_CLIENT_ID drawn from Tools → IBKR for the active paper/live mode.

✅ IBKR PRE-FLIGHT IS SMART NOW
• In IBKR mode, starting a custom bot first checks: the bot has a Client ID in Tools → IBKR, AND the gateway port is reachable. Specific error message if either is missing — no more 'assign Alpaca key' dialog.
• Built-in bots (LONG / SHORT / DAY) still call Alpaca directly. They're BLOCKED in IBKR mode with a clear 'refactor coming next release' message so they can't silently trade Alpaca from the IBKR view.

What's next: refactor LONG / SHORT / DAY to use the same broker abstraction (so all bots execute on IBKR), then add per-broker bot processes on the Oracle server (so the same bot can run on Alpaca AND IBKR simultaneously on the cloud).
